identity.naming_note: The live owner's manual names the base trim 'Model Y'; the Dec-2025 PDF and third parties call it 'Standard'. 'Long Range' was the pre-Oct-2025 name of what is now Premium (ADAC/illumaesthetic use it).
cargo_geometry_trim_differences: Second-row fold: Standard uses manual release straps (4 recline positions); Premium/Performance have power fold with switches on the seats, on both touchscreens, and on the left rear-trunk wall (owner's manual).

Rear trunk floor: Tesla sells separate floor-liner styles 'Model Y' ($195) and 'Model Y Premium and Performance' ($220), plus '7 Seat Interior', so the upper cargo floor or trim differs between Standard and Premium/Performance. The cause is undocumented.
Sub-trunk well: one liner style for all 5-seat cars ('5 Seat Interior') vs a separate 7-seat style, so the well is likely shared across 5-seat trims.
Parcel shelf: included on Premium/Performance, $135 accessory on Standard.
Volumes: Standard 29.5 cu ft behind row 2 / 70.8 folded; Premium 5-seat and Performance 29.0 / 71.4; Premium 7-seat 27.1 (3rd row folded) / 69.4 / 13.1 behind row 3.
Ride height affects load-lip height: unladen ground clearance Standard 6.4 in, Premium 6.6 in, Performance 6.0 in.
Frunk: two variants by tow-eye position (110 lb sealed vs 65 lb unsealed limit); trim mapping not stated.
identity.body_caveat: No official or reputable linear trunk dimensions exist for the 2025+ body beyond ADAC's 68 cm load lip and Tesla's body-in-white datum figure. All floor/width/opening numbers in this vault are from the 2020-2024 body (Tesmanian), recorded as SUBSTITUTION, or are low-confidence.

body_equivalence.rule: Physical body measurements from another market apply to the US 2025+ body only when that market's stated wheelbase, width and height agree with the US owner's manual within 0.5%. CN: 2890/1920/1624 vs US 2890/1920/1621-1624 (0.0%, 0.0%, <=0.2%). EU: 1921/1624 vs 1920/1624 (0.05%, 0.0%).

spin_360.notes: tesla.com configurator shows a stepped carousel of fixed server-rendered views (compositor views FRONT34, SIDE, REAR34, RIMCLOSEUP, plus interior), not a drag-to-spin 360. tesla.com/modely has static images and videos only. Tesla sells direct, so there is no major-retailer product page; dealer marketplaces (KBB/Autotrader) show per-listing 360 badges on some used 2026 Model Y listings (search result only, not opened). These are per-car dealer photos, not a product asset. The illumaesthetic scan page has a '360° Photos' viewer of its scanned car (third-party, paid product).

collection_gaps: LIVE MANUAL PDF NOT SAVED: tesla.com/ownersmanual/modely/en_us/Owners_Manual.pdf (software 2026.32, 16,404,611 bytes) loads in the browser, but curl/WebFetch get HTTP 403 (bot protection), and handing bytes from the browser to a local receiver stalled at Chrome's local-network permission (not granted). Stored the newest valid Wayback capture instead (2026-01-16, software 2025.44). The Wayback 2026-02-10 capture is truncated (5 MiB). The newer live text for trunk sections is in manuals/owners-manual-live-sections-2026-10-07.md.

NO OFFICIAL TRUNK LINEAR DIMENSIONS: Tesla publishes no liftgate opening width/height, floor length, wheel-arch width, interior height, sub-trunk L×W×depth, frunk L×W×depth, or seatback angle for the 2025+ Model Y (manual, tesla.com, shop, Collision Repair manual checked).

NO 2025+ THIRD-PARTY TAPE MEASUREMENTS: beyond ADAC's 68 cm load lip, no reputable linear measurements of the 2025+ trunk were found (ADAC/ÖAMTC, Car and Driver, Basenor, Tesloid, TMC forum threads, kofferraum.org checked). Legacy 2020 Tesmanian measurements are stored as SUBSTITUTION. teslamotorsclub.com returns 403 to WebFetch; one Juniper comparison thread was read in the browser and had no measurements. Reddit, MotorTrend, Car and Driver are blocked to the search tool's crawler.

Collision Repair manual figures: service.tesla.com blocks curl and has no Wayback copy; only a screen capture of the rear-body figure was stored (not original bytes). The other 6 figures are not trunk-relevant and are referenced by URL.

Owner's manual illustrations (live HTML) are served from tesla.com and blocked to curl; they are not stored separately. Equivalent illustrations are inside the vault PDF (pages listed in geometry/trunk-geometry.md). Extracting them would create derivatives, which belong outside the vault (README rule 4).

tesla.com configurator renders (static-assets.tesla.com/configurator/compositor) return 403 to curl, so no clean studio rear/side/trunk-open renders in a chosen paint were stored. Images come from digitalassets.tesla.com (marketing) and digitalassets-shop.tesla.com (accessory shots).
Model Y Performance spec panel on tesla.com/modely was not captured: the tab click did not render a Performance panel in the DOM. Performance dimensions come from the owner's manual instead.

Which body the Tesla shop 5-seat liner gallery images (prefix 2048569) depict is not confirmed. The page says the product fits 2025+, but the same images serve both the Standard and Premium/Performance styles.
No 2025+ official Tesla-hosted video of trunk/liftgate/seat folding found; the stored Five-Seater tutorial shows the legacy interior. YouTube URLs recorded only.
Rear subwoofer / audio intrusion into the trunk side wall on Premium vs Standard: not documented in any source checked.
GVWR/GAWR and occupant+cargo payload not published online; printed on each car's door-pillar labels.
